Rekindling the Verdant Years Chapter 101: Li Luo, You Stop Right There

On Saturday, school was dismissed at noon.

But students in competition clubs had to stay at school for intensive training in their respective classrooms.

Ying Chanxi had to continue with classes in the afternoon, so Li Luo, being idle and bored, was invited by Yan Zhusheng to check out the rock club.

"Your rock club has activities every week too?" Li Luo said as he walked beside Yan Zhusheng towards the school's gymnasium.

Because the rock club used musical instruments, holding their activities in the academic building might disturb students in other classrooms.

So the school had arranged for the rock club to be in an activity room on the second floor of the gymnasium.

"We have group practice recently," Yan Zhusheng said. "The school sports meet is at the end of the month, and our band will perform at the opening and closing ceremonies."

"Whoa, you guys are for real?" Li Luo was a bit surprised. He thought school clubs were just for students to mess around, but they actually got to perform on stage.

In his previous life, his high school didn't even have a band, let alone performing on stage.

The opening ceremony for the sports meet was just each class walking past the front of the sports field, then listening to the principal's long-winded speeches while the students baked in the sun below.

But here at Fuyi High, they actually gave the school band a chance to perform on stage.

"Hey, you're here."

On the second floor of the gymnasium, a short-haired girl who was setting up a drum kit in the corner saw Li Luo and Yan Zhusheng arrive together and greeted them with a smile. "The others aren't here yet, you'll have to wait a bit."

"Okay, sure," Yan Zhusheng nodded, walked over to a nearby cabinet, and took out her guitar.

"Zhusheng, Qian Siliang is on leave today, so you take the keyboard," Niu Qingling said from behind the drum kit in the corner. "Li Luo, want to mess around with the guitar?"

"Me?" Li Luo hesitated for a moment. "Didn't she say you guys are practicing songs for the sports meet? As an outsider, I probably shouldn't butt in."

"Xie Shuchen is coming later, but he said he'd be a bit late. Can you fill in for him for now?" Niu Qingling said.

"Alright, then."

The rock club had very few members.

After three third-year seniors quit the club following the National Day holiday, there were only eight people left.

Among them, Niu Qingling was the drummer and the newly appointed president of the rock club.

Besides her, there were four first-year students and three from the second year.

Among these seven people, besides Yan Zhusheng, there was a bassist, two guitarists, one keyboardist, and two lead singers.

One of the guitarists and one of the lead singers were in their second year and had to focus on competitions and training. So even though they hadn't quit the club, it was almost as if they had, since they rarely showed up.

So now, they could barely scrape together a band, with one person for each position, and Yan Zhusheng as a floater, filling in wherever she was needed.

A little while later, Wei Duo, the lead singer, and Shao Youpeng, the bassist, also arrived.

Li Luo had nothing better to do, and seeing that Xie Shuchen hadn't arrived yet, he temporarily took the guitarist's spot. He joined Yan Zhusheng and the others in messing around, practicing "Brave Heart," the song they planned to perform at the opening ceremony.

Li Luo had a great time, as he was just a temporary member anyway.

When Xie Shuchen rushed over after three in the afternoon, Li Luo stepped aside and quietly enjoyed the band's performance.

However, at four in the afternoon, during the band's mid-session break, the lead singer Wei Duo pulled Niu Qingling aside privately.

It was unclear what was said, but when the two of them returned, their expressions were a bit grim.

"Let's just practice up to here for today. Everyone can go home and rest," Niu Qingling announced upon her return.

But the others weren't fools; they could clearly sense that something was wrong.

After Wei Duo left first, Li Luo asked curiously, "What happened?"

"Um..." Niu Qingling forced a rather ugly smile. "I'll probably have to tell the teacher. I don't think we can perform at the sports meet anymore."

"What do you mean we can't perform?" Xie Shuchen cried out from the side. "I was practicing the whole National Day holiday. Why can't we perform? What did Wei Duo just say?"

"She's not coming anymore, is she?" Shao Youpeng snorted. "I remember she has the chemistry competition coming up. She probably doesn't want to waste her time."

"Yeah, that's about it." Niu Qingling clutched her head, looking troubled. "We probably won't have enough people for the sports meet. We'll have to wait for the New Year's Gala at the end of the year. Everyone should be free then."

"Tsk." Xie Shuchen was a little annoyed. He had been looking forward to showing off at the sports meet for a long time. He'd even told Ying Chanxi about it before coming today, and now it was canceled just like that. "Can't the few of us do it? How about I sing?"

"Uh..." Niu Qingling looked at Xie Shuchen, pondered for a moment, and then said, "Then why don't we give it a try?"

The group got back into motion, only this time, Xie Shuchen was both the guitarist and the lead singer.

The moment he held the microphone, Xie Shuchen felt a surge of excitement. He began to fantasize about himself on stage at the sports meet, full of passion, and the feeling made him a little giddy.

But reality quickly brought him crashing down.

If it was just simply strumming some chords on the guitar and singing a folk song, Xie Shuchen had no problem.

But when it came to singing a rock song like "Brave Heart," Xie Shuchen's already limited singing skills were severely stretched.

He couldn't hit the high notes, and when he tried to force it during the chorus, his voice became a cracking rasp.

Once he went off-key, he couldn't play the guitar steadily either, and it was riddled with mistakes.

Halfway through the performance, Niu Qingling called a halt, saying helplessly, "How about we just forget it. The sports meet happens every year anyway."

"It won't be our turn next year, President," Shao Youpeng rolled his eyes from the side. "If this really isn't going to work, I'm just going to focus on the physics competition. I was only making time for this as it is."

If it wasn't for wanting to show off in front of Xu Youyu, and the fact that Yan Zhusheng was easy on the eyes, Shao Youpeng would have bailed long ago.

At this moment, Li Luo, who had been watching from the side, couldn't help but ask, "Senior, why don't you let Zhusheng sing?"

"Huh?" Niu Qingling was taken aback. "Can she sing?"

"Wait... you didn't know?" Li Luo was stunned too. He turned his head to look at Yan Zhusheng. "You never told her?"

"Hm?" Yan Zhusheng tilted her head. "I did. I said I could do any position."

"But..." Niu Qingling opened her mouth.

In her memory, when Yan Zhusheng auditioned, she had played all the instruments one after another right from the start. She could even play the drums decently, showing she had truly learned them.

So Niu Qingling had never even considered the possibility of Yan Zhusheng singing and had subconsciously assigned her to other positions.

"Here, sing a few lines." Li Luo handed the microphone to Yan Zhusheng. "Just 'Brave Heart,' the chorus, 'This is the feeling of flying...'"

"This is the feeling of flying."

"This is the feeling of freedom."

Yan Zhusheng took the microphone, closed her eyes, and then sang a couple of lines a cappella. She instantly got into character, and the explosive power and strength in her high notes completely stunned Niu Qingling.

"See, she can do it," Li Luo said with a smile.

"But." The surprise on Niu Qingling's face was fleeting, then she said with some difficulty, "But if she does that, the keyboardist position will be empty."

"What about Qian Siliang?"

"He said he was on leave, but he's taken leave several times already. It basically means he's not coming anymore..."

"Uh... then how about me?" Xie Shuchen volunteered. "My piano skills are a little better than my guitar. I just don't know how different it is from a keyboard."

"We can give it a try." Niu Qingling's eyes lit up. "It's not that different. You just need to be able to read sheet music."

"In that case, Xie Shuchen on keyboard, Shao Youpeng on bass, Zhusheng, you're on lead vocals, and then..."

At this point, Niu Qingling's gaze landed on Li Luo. "Li Luo, want to play?"

"...Yan Zhusheng can play and sing at the same time." Li Luo's mouth twitched, wondering how he'd gotten dragged into this.

But Yan Zhusheng, holding the microphone, took a step back and then said, "I can't."

Li Luo: "?"

"Oh, just do it," Niu Qingling said, shoving a guitar into his hands. "Do you have any competitions to prepare for?"

"...No."

"Any other club activities to attend?"

"I'm in the basketball club..."

"Did you go to the school team tryouts for the basketball club?"

"...No, but I'm also in the literature club."

"For the literature club, you just have to submit one manuscript a month," Yan Zhusheng added.

Li Luo: "...You're pretty sharp at times like this."

"I was never dumb to begin with," Yan Zhusheng said matter-of-factly, a hint of delight in her eyes.

She looked like a kitten succeeding in its first act of mischief.

After five in the evening, they left the rock club.

Li Luo looked at the club application form in his hand and sighed, "Somehow I've been tricked onto a pirate ship."

"Your guitar skills still aren't good enough," Yan Zhusheng reminded him from the side. "I can teach you, for free."

"Oh, thank you so much."

The two walked back to their classroom to pack their schoolbags.

A moment later, Ying Chanxi came down from upstairs.

"Li Luo, come upstairs and help me with something."

"Hm? What's wrong?" Li Luo packed his bag and followed Ying Chanxi up to the fourth floor, only to see her take out five or six fluffy stuffed toys and thrust them into his arms.

Li Luo looked down and saw dolls, a small crocodile, and cat and dog designs.

Liu Shaowen bought this many stuffed animals?

Li Luo was inwardly surprised and couldn't help asking, "Who sent all of these?"

"I have no idea what's going on," Ying Chanxi said, wiping her forehead, looking exasperated. "Several guys gave me gifts today, and they were all these kinds of stuffed toys. I can't carry them all by myself."

"If you don't want them, you could have just refused, right?"

"The problem is, I have no idea who sent them." Ying Chanxi was completely baffled. "When I came back from my tutoring session, these stuffed toys were on my desk. My classmates who were in the classroom earlier said they were gifts from several different guys, but they don't know who."

Li Luo: "..."

Looking at the stuffed toys in his arms, Li Luo felt inexplicably guilty.

But he had clearly only told Liu Shaowen...

Just as he was thinking this, Yan Zhusheng also came upstairs. She took out a cute stuffed toy from her own schoolbag and handed it to Ying Chanxi. "For you."

Ying Chanxi blinked, not quite processing it. "Zhusheng, why are you giving me this?"

"A gift between friends," Yan Zhusheng said. "Mom said I should be nice to my friends."

"But why is it a stuffed toy too..."

"Li Luo said so. He said you like stuffed toys."

Ying Chanxi: "?"

"Li Luo! Don't you run!"

"I don't know anything!"

"Stop right there! If you're not guilty, why are you running!"

(End of Chapter)
